title: Assemble a Degraded Package
subtitle: Ready with a loaner - exceptions named
scenario: Hardware was blocked but escalation issued a loaner, so the hire can start. Assemble the package in degraded mode: honest about the exception, but showing the hire is ready to work. Fill every slot by lookup - the tracker and escalation record hold the truth.
input: Assembly rule: every slot from a stored artifact. Hire name and role from onboarding-record.json. States from task-tracker.json (accounts, access, payroll done; hardware blocked). The escalation issued a loaner, so hardware shows 'loaner' and readiness is 'Ready with loaner'. Start date is SD.
instructions: Fill the header slots from the onboarding record.
Fill accounts, access, payroll from the tracker (done).
Show hardware as 'loaner' and readiness as 'Ready with loaner' from the escalation.
Validate to render the degraded day-one-package.md.

sections.title: Degraded is still ready
sections.body: Perfect is not the bar - ready is. With a loaner in hand, the hire can work on day one. The package says so, while naming the exception so nobody is surprised.

sections.title: Name the exception
sections.body: Hiding the backorder would make the package a lie the day the ordered laptop is late. Showing 'loaner' and the exception line keeps it trustworthy.

sections.title: Still by lookup
sections.body: Even in degraded mode you assemble from artifacts - the tracker's states and the escalation's resolution. The exception is data, not a story you write.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A truthful degraded package: ready with a loaner, the exception named, every line traceable.

takeaway.heading: Degraded package assembled
points: You assembled a package that is ready with a loaner, not blocked.
The backorder exception is named, so the package stays honest.
Every slot - including the loaner - came from a stored artifact.
Readiness is truthful: the hire can work while the laptop ships.
The workflow can now certify a hire ready in degraded mode without hiding the exception.
